card.name: Intensifying adjectives before nouns
card.fires_on: Mostly on an adjective or adverb of degree or manner (marginalized, concerted, painstaking, marked, intentional) just before the noun it describes. Also seen partway through some longer words.

modes.label: Adjective before noun
modes.description: A describing word of degree or effort sits right before a noun such as attack, work or overdosage.
